source_time_text: Sep 15, 3:01am FF / linked data released 02:00 UTC

immediate.rationale: Weak Chinese retail demand and deeper investment contraction are negative for the China-sensitive Australian equity market despite stronger industrial output.

next_session.rationale: Legacy logic keeps a modest negative China-growth impulse into the next session.

predictions.mechanism: China demand weakness weighs on Australian miners, cyclicals and regional risk sentiment.
predictions.invalidation: A broad China stimulus response or strong commodity-led risk rebound would weaken the bearish view.
